sources.title: Directed flow in non-adiabatic stochastic pumps
sources.read_depth: Full main HTML argument through equations (1)-(13), no-pumping derivation, cyclic/periodic discussion and many-body caveat; bibliography inspected as navigation only.
sources.supports: The pump identity and geometric/no-pumping interpretation are established prior art. Varying both well and barrier responses is relevant. Many-body state energies change the single-particle no-pumping interface.
sources.limits: Does not establish the proposed solid-state material experiment, its historical novelty or any acquired coefficients. HTML generated date is not publication date; publication metadata verified on arXiv abstract page.

sources.title: The persistence of memory in ionic conduction probed by nonlinear optics
sources.read_depth: Publisher abstract and main sections through correlated hopping discussion: distinct sites, 0.7-3 THz ionic vibrations, approximately 10 ps room-temperature K beta-alumina relaxation, optical observable parity and correlated back-hopping. Later reopen failed because of publisher authentication redirect; PMC mirror returned reCAPTCHA.
sources.supports: Material motivation and the distinction between hopping-axis anisotropy and signed ionic transport. The measured optical signal receives positive contributions from both forward and backward hops along the pump axis; it cannot establish a net directed pump.
sources.limits: No experiment data reanalysis, no acquired site/saddle derivative matrix, no validation of independent-ion Markov rates. The source packet's optical-to-THz energy conversion numbers were not independently reverified in methods.

sources.title: Correlated terahertz phonon-ion interactions control ion conduction in a solid electrolyte
sources.read_depth: Author record and targeted manuscript text: pages 2,4-8,17-18; Fig. 4-6 discussions, impedance/ultrafast geometries, 250 Hz source, 0.78 percent per mW slope and 1.03 ns transient. Not all 47 manuscript/SI pages were read. Publisher HTML separately failed.
sources.supports: The impedance and GHz transient configurations differ. The 0.78 percent quantity is a slope per mW; the 19 GHz transient has a 1.03 plus/minus 0.03 ns fitted decay. Same-observable impulse area is not acquired by combining these numbers.
sources.limits: No contradiction of the paper, no assertion of enormous instantaneous conductivity, no claimed metastable-state discovery and no directed-transport measurement.

sources.title: Nonlinear phononics: A new ultrafast route to lattice control
sources.read_depth: Main author-manuscript text pages 1-6, equations (1)-(5), IR-to-Raman coupling and experimental interpretation; bibliography only as navigation.
sources.supports: Ionic Raman scattering and anharmonic lattice rectification are prior art; the even Raman coordinate is driven through a squared odd IR coordinate in the stated symmetry setting.
sources.limits: Does not supply beta-alumina couplings, accessible two-coordinate motion, ionic cell translation, retention or an engineering advantage.

not_reviewed_here: Other entries of producer SOURCES.json are preserved metadata only; their full text, current status and applicability were not independently audited. Search results outside the four primary sources were used only for navigation and are not scientific evidence in this report.
prior_art_conclusion: Geometric stochastic pumping and nonlinear phononics are known. Specific beta-alumina implementation priority remains UNKNOWN; no exhaustive paper or patent search was completed.
